structure.unit: School Boards; Selection, Qualification and Salaries of Members
Alternate Method of Selecting School Boards in School Divisions Comprised of a Single County

law.text: The provisions of this article shall be applicable in any county constituting a school division except a county to which the provisions of §§ 15.2-410, 15.2-531, 15.2-627 or § 15.2-837 are applicable.
